title: David and Goliath Crossword Puzzle — Bible Crossword
heading: The David & Goliath Crossword
description: A David and Goliath Bible crossword from 1 Samuel 17: five smooth stones, a sling, and a shepherd boy's faith. Play free on iPhone and iPad.
prose: Five smooth stones from the brook, a sling, and a shepherd boy who refused the king's armour — the duel in the valley of Elah is Scripture's great underdog story. The David and Goliath puzzle builds its grid from the details: the brass helmet of the giant, King Saul watching from the lines, the shield-bearer walking ahead.

When the last square fills in, the puzzle ends on David's answer to the Philistine — “I come to thee in the name of the LORD of hosts.” A 7×7 mini, The Shepherd and the Giant, retells it in quick form, and King David continues the story into the Psalms.

clues.text: Stream where the stones were gathered
Metal of the giant's heavy helmet
Towering champion of the enemy army
King who reigned during the duel

verseText: But David said to the Philistine, ‘You come against me with sword and spear and javelin, but I come against you in the name of the LORD of Hosts, the God of the armies of Israel, whom you have defied.’
